name: Figma Mutation Recovery Policy
entryCondition: Any write call errors, times out, returns incomplete affected-node evidence, or reports an unexpected result.

writeStateClassification.NO_WRITE: Direct evidence shows no planned mutation reached canvas.
writeStateClassification.PARTIAL_WRITE: One or more planned operations reached canvas but the batch did not complete.
writeStateClassification.UNKNOWN_WRITE: Canvas state cannot be proven from the failed call; mandatory read-only inspection before any retry.
writeStateClassification.RECOVERED: Canvas is restored/corrected to a verified coherent state.

procedure: Read safeToRetryWithoutCanvasRead when provided by the Figma execution layer.
If safeToRetryWithoutCanvasRead is false or absent/uncertain, inspect affected target before retry.
Classify canvas as NO_WRITE, PARTIAL_WRITE, or UNKNOWN_WRITE.
For PARTIAL_WRITE/UNKNOWN_WRITE, compare affected nodes against pre-batch fingerprint and operation plan.
Create the smallest recovery plan; never assume transaction rollback exists.
Re-check target, scope, permission, and reference eligibility.
Apply recovery/corrected operation only when safe.
Verify canvas state before returning to normal flow.
